name: islands
description: Expression islands: contiguous runs of transcription units with unusually high or low detrended abundance scores (GIPPA_SPEC.md §9.3, §7.3.5(d)).

fields.name: island_id
fields.description: Island identifier, numbered from 1 in table order

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Direction of the island

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon name (C1 order)

fields.name: start
fields.description: Island start, 1-based

fields.name: end
fields.description: Island end, 1-based closed; > replicon length for an origin-crossing island

fields.name: tu_first
fields.description: First transcription unit of the island

fields.name: tu_last
fields.description: Last transcription unit of the island

fields.name: n_tus
fields.description: Number of transcription units in the island

fields.name: n_genes
fields.description: Number of eligible genes in the island's TUs

fields.name: genes
fields.description: Semicolon-joined locus tags of the island's eligible genes

fields.name: mean_abundance_log2
fields.description: Mean log2 abundance of the detected genes of the island

fields.name: detected_frac
fields.description: Share of the island's eligible genes that are detected

fields.name: scan_s
fields.description: Scan statistic S of the island's best window

fields.name: block_len
fields.description: Bootstrap block length l' used for the replicon

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Name of the test statistic of the row; its value is scan_s

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Mean detrended TU score over the island's best window

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of the effect

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of the effect

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: Genome-wide FWER p-value of the best window

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: Always NA: the scan controls the FWER, not the FDR

fields.name: method
fields.description: Method that produced the row

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null the FWER p-value is drawn from

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Valid bootstrap replicates behind the FWER p-value

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined flags from the controlled vocabulary (§9.4)
